## 💡 What This Folder Is For

The fill-in documents for the first pages a newcomer opens: how to get from a
clean machine to a passing test run, and where the project is heading over the
next year. Each decision is marked by `[square brackets]` until your project
makes it.

Copy a file out to `docs/introduction/` under the same name, then replace every
bracket. The seed here stays pristine.

The commands in Getting Started are the ones CI runs, taken from
`.github/workflows/checks.yml`, so a newcomer and CI never disagree about what
passing means. Change both in the same pull request.
